ideas.pitch: An interactive web simulator for predicting the structural and functional consequences of single nucleotide polymorphisms in molecular biology.
ideas.problem_statement: Evaluate fundamentals of Molecular Biology and Genetics.
ideas.title: GeneMutate-Predict
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core evaluation objective of molecular biology fundamentals while providing an engaging visual interface that appeals to judges assessing scientific understanding.

ideas.pitch: A predictive dashboard for monitoring and optimizing fermentation kinetics and bioprocess engineering variables in real time.
ideas.title: BioProcess-Optimize
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles bioprocess engineering with a quantitative, data-driven approach that demonstrates applied biological principles and analytical abilities.

ideas.pitch: A computational tool for modeling enzyme-substrate interactions, Michaelis-Menten kinetics, and biochemical pathways.
ideas.problem_statement: Assess understanding of Biochemistry and Microbiology.
ideas.title: EnzymeKinetics-Sim
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep interdisciplinary biochemical understanding through working simulation models that judges can interact with live.

ideas.pitch: An interactive cell biology platform simulating checkpoint regulations, mitosis phases, and cellular responses to stressors.
ideas.problem_statement: Test concepts related to Cell Biology.
ideas.title: CellCycle-Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Translates complex cell biology concepts into a clear, demonstrable visual application showcasing strong scientific reasoning.

ideas.pitch: A genetic engineering utility for planning restriction enzyme digests, ligation strategies, and vector map generation.
ideas.problem_statement: Strengthen knowledge of Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology.
ideas.title: PlasmidDesign-Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a practical workflow problem for genetic engineering students, combining software engineering with applied biotechnology.
